units: bytes, except tiers in MiB (2^20 bytes), utilization as a fraction
definition: Size budget and prediction apply to linked text growth above the unbaked guest baseline. Positive residual means underprediction. The guard is the historical empirical 90th percentile. Links and independent historical folds are separate populations.
symbol_method: Thin Mach-O __TEXT,__text; LC_FUNCTION_STARTS to next function start (last to end of text), including alignment. For binding bodies, map tail/scalar entry points to selected words, exclude addresses carrying baseline symbols, count unique addresses, split aliases between their owners. Resolver growth sums three disjoint named function spans, less baseline spans. Other growth reconciles these buckets to the measured total. Cache sums are prior to class multipliers. Captured SHA-256 identifies active binaries that the trainer discarded after measuring.
